title: Qualtrics Brand Tracking (XM / BrandXM)
author_source: Qualtrics, SaaS survey platform with brand-tracker solution and templates, 2026
note: Survey-based brand tracker: awareness, consideration, preference, loyalty funnel, brand associations, competitor benchmarks, automated alerts; brand-tracker survey templates for the consumer-based part of a brand audit (CBBE inventory).
course_use: Project: students build a brand awareness/image questionnaire and field it. WU-Lizenz prüfen (WU provides Qualtrics/Unipark for courses and theses); the commercial brand-tracker module is paid enterprise.

title: Unipark / Tivian EFS Survey
author_source: Tivian (formerly Questback), SaaS online-survey software with academic programme 'Unipark', 2026
note: German-language survey platform widely used at DACH universities; matrix rating scales for brand attributes, Likert CBBE items (Keller/Aaker), randomised brand blocks, export to SPSS/R.
course_use: Lab: programme a brand image survey for 3-5 competing brands; Unipark academic licence - WU-Lizenz prüfen.

title: LimeSurvey
author_source: LimeSurvey GmbH, open-source survey tool (GPL-2.0+), Community Edition 6.x self-hosted or LimeSurvey Cloud, 2026
note: Free alternative for brand perception questionnaires: array/matrix questions for attribute ratings, semantic differentials, unaided brand recall (open text), quotas; export to CSV/R/SPSS; EU hosting.
course_use: Lab/project: free (self-hosted, open source) or free cloud plan (25 responses/month); paid cloud plans from ~EUR 29/month.

title: SurveyMonkey (brand awareness / brand perception templates)
author_source: SurveyMonkey (Momentive), SaaS, 2026
note: Survey platform with brand awareness and brand perception templates and an optional panel (SurveyMonkey Audience) to field a quick brand tracker.
course_use: Project: pilot surveys; free basic plan (10 questions); paid plans from ~EUR 30/month; panel completes charged extra.

title: YouGov BrandIndex (incl. BrandIndex Lite)
author_source: YouGov plc, SaaS syndicated daily brand tracker, 55 markets incl. Austria/Germany, API and MCP access, 2026
note: Daily brand-health metrics (Index, Buzz, Impression, Quality, Value, Reputation, Satisfaction, Recommend, Awareness, Consideration, Purchase intent, Current customer) for thousands of brands; competitor benchmarking in the brand-exploratory phase.
course_use: Demo/guest lecture; commercial licence (paid); free BrandIndex Lite tier listed by YouGov; no general academic programme found - ask YouGov.

title: Kantar BrandZ / Meaningful-Different-Salient framework
author_source: Kantar, brand equity research and valuation, 2026
note: BrandZ brand equity model (Meaningful, Different, Salient) and Most Valuable Brands rankings; methodology to contrast survey-based equity with financial brand valuation.
course_use: Reading/benchmark; methodology and rankings free online (registration for reports); custom tracking paid.

title: Latana - AI-powered brand tracking
author_source: Latana GmbH (Berlin), SaaS brand tracker using MRP-based audience modelling, 2026
note: Always-on brand tracking (awareness, consideration, associations) by granular target-group segments; example of modern panel-based brand-health tracking in DACH.
course_use: Demo/case input; paid (custom pricing).

title: Tracksuit - always-on brand tracking
author_source: Tracksuit (NZ/global), SaaS brand-funnel tracker, 2026
note: Monthly brand-funnel tracking (unprompted/prompted awareness, consideration, preference, competitor comparison) aimed at SMEs; illustrates brand-funnel metrics for the brand inventory.
course_use: Demo/case; paid (subscription, market dependent).

title: Brandwatch Consumer Research
author_source: Brandwatch (Cision), SaaS social listening and consumer research, 2026
note: Boolean-query listening over 100m+ online sources; mention volume, share of voice, sentiment, emotion, topic clusters, demographics - evidence for brand associations and brand image.
course_use: Project if licence available; paid enterprise - WU-Lizenz prüfen.

title: Talkwalker (Hootsuite)
author_source: Talkwalker / Hootsuite, SaaS social listening and AI analytics, 2026
note: Social and media listening with share of voice, sentiment, logo/image recognition (visual listening) and brand-health dashboards; free Talkwalker Alerts as lightweight alternative.
course_use: Demo; enterprise paid; Talkwalker Alerts free for simple mention tracking.

title: Meltwater
author_source: Meltwater, SaaS media intelligence and social listening, 2026
note: Earned-media and social monitoring incl. Austrian/German press; share of voice, sentiment, media reach - media coverage part of the brand exploratory.
course_use: Demo/guest lecture; paid enterprise.

title: Brand24
author_source: Brand24 Global Inc. (Poland), SaaS social listening, 2026
note: Low-cost mention monitoring: volume, reach, sentiment, share of voice, influencer score, AI insights; suitable for student groups auditing a local brand.
course_use: Project: 14-day free trial; paid from ~USD 79/month.

title: Mention
author_source: Mention (Agorapulse), SaaS media monitoring, 2026
note: Real-time web and social mention monitoring with sentiment and competitor comparison; brand buzz/awareness evidence.
course_use: Project: free trial; paid plans (~USD 40-50/month entry).

title: Awario
author_source: Awario, SaaS social listening, 2026
note: Budget social listening with Boolean queries, sentiment, share of voice and competitor analysis.
course_use: Project: 7-day free trial; paid from ~USD 29/month.

title: Google Trends (+ gtrendsR / pytrends)
author_source: Google LLC, free web tool; R gtrendsR 1.5.2 (GPL >= 2); Python pytrends 4.9.2 (Apache-2.0, unofficial API), 2026
note: Relative search interest by brand, region (Austria/Bundesland) and time; 'share of search' as indicator of brand salience; R/Python packages pull series for analysis.
course_use: Lab: compute share of search for 3-5 competitors in Austria; free/open source.

title: Semrush (incl. AI Visibility Toolkit)
author_source: Semrush Inc., SaaS SEO/marketing suite, 2026
note: Branded vs. non-branded keyword volume, organic share of voice, traffic estimates, backlinks; AI Visibility Toolkit measures brand presence in AI answers.
course_use: Project: free account with limited queries; paid from ~USD 140/month.

title: Ahrefs Brand Radar
author_source: Ahrefs Pte. Ltd., SaaS SEO suite, 2026
note: Tracks brand mentions, branded search demand and AI-assistant visibility vs. competitors; Keywords Explorer for branded search volume.
course_use: Demo/project; paid; free Ahrefs Webmaster Tools only for own sites.

title: Similarweb
author_source: Similarweb Ltd., SaaS digital market intelligence, 2026
note: Website traffic, channel mix, audience overlap and branded search share for competing brands - digital touchpoint part of a brand audit.
course_use: Project: free basic website lookup; paid plans for full data.

title: Profound - AI visibility / answer engine analytics
author_source: Profound (New York), SaaS AI search visibility tracker, 2026
note: Tracks how often and how favourably a brand appears in ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and Google AI Overviews answers; cited sources and share of voice in LLM answers - the 'AI brand perception' layer of an audit.
course_use: Demo/discussion; paid enterprise.

title: Otterly.AI
author_source: OtterlyAI GmbH (Vienna, Austria), SaaS AI search monitoring, 2026
note: Monitors brand mentions, rank and cited links across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews/AI Mode, Copilot; prompt-based brand visibility reports. Austrian start-up - potential guest speaker.
course_use: Project: free trial; paid from ~USD 29/month.

title: Peec AI
author_source: Peec AI GmbH (Berlin), SaaS AI search analytics, 2026
note: Tracks brand visibility, position and sentiment in AI assistant answers vs. competitors, with source analysis; prompt-based tracking.
course_use: Demo/project; paid (entry plans reported ~EUR 75-105/month; check peec.ai/pricing).

title: vaderSentiment (Python)
author_source: C.J. Hutto, PyPI vaderSentiment 3.3.2, MIT licence
note: Lexicon/rule-based sentiment for social media text; fast polarity scores for brand tweets/reviews (English).
course_use: Lab: score sentiment of brand mentions; free/open source.

title: Hugging Face transformers + cardiffnlp twitter-roberta sentiment models
author_source: Hugging Face, PyPI transformers 5.19.0 (Apache-2.0); model cardiffnlp/twitter-roberta-base-sentiment-latest
note: Transformer (RoBERTa) 3-class sentiment for tweets; multilingual variant (twitter-xlm-roberta-base-sentiment) for German-language brand mentions.
course_use: Lab (Colab): compare lexicon vs. transformer sentiment on brand mentions; free/open source.

title: BERTopic
author_source: Maarten Grootendorst, PyPI bertopic 0.17.4, MIT licence
note: Embedding-based topic modelling to surface brand associations/themes from reviews or social posts; dynamic topics over time.
course_use: Lab: extract association clusters from brand reviews; free/open source.

title: spaCy
author_source: Explosion AI, PyPI spacy 3.8.16, MIT licence
note: NLP pipeline with NER (ORG/PRODUCT) and German models to detect brand mentions and co-occurring attributes for brand association networks.
course_use: Lab: NER-based brand mention extraction; free/open source.

title: tidytext (R)
author_source: Julia Silge & David Robinson, CRAN tidytext 0.4.3, MIT licence
note: Tidy text mining with sentiment lexicons (AFINN, Bing, NRC), tf-idf and n-grams to compare brand associations across competitors.
course_use: Lab: sentiment/tf-idf of brand reviews; free/open source.

title: quanteda (R)
author_source: Kenneth Benoit et al., CRAN quanteda 4.5.0, GPL-3
note: Corpus handling, dictionaries (brand attribute dictionaries), keyness and feature co-occurrence networks - brand association maps from text.
course_use: Lab: keyness brand A vs. brand B; free/open source.

title: sentimentr (R)
author_source: Tyler Rinker, CRAN sentimentr 2.9.0, MIT licence
note: Sentence-level sentiment with valence shifters (negation, amplifiers) - more accurate polarity of brand reviews than plain lexicon counts.
course_use: Lab; free/open source.

title: FactoMineR + factoextra (R) - perceptual maps
author_source: Husson, Josse, Le, Mazet; CRAN FactoMineR 2.17 (GPL >= 2), factoextra 2.2.0 (GPL-2)
note: Correspondence analysis of brand x attribute tables and PCA of brand ratings to draw perceptual/positioning maps; factoextra for ggplot2 visualisation.
course_use: Lab: perceptual map from Chapman & Feit brand ratings; free/open source.

title: smacof + MASS (R) - multidimensional scaling
author_source: de Leeuw & Mair (smacof 2.1-7, GPL-3); Ripley et al. (MASS 7.3-66, GPL-2|3), CRAN
note: Metric/non-metric MDS of brand (dis)similarity judgements for perceptual maps; MASS::isoMDS as classic alternative.
course_use: Lab: MDS map from brand similarity survey; free/open source.

title: lavaan (R) - CFA of CBBE scales
author_source: Yves Rosseel, CRAN lavaan 0.7-3, GPL (>= 2)
note: Confirmatory factor analysis/SEM to validate consumer-based brand equity scales (e.g. Yoo & Donthu: awareness/associations, perceived quality, loyalty) and test measurement invariance across brands.
course_use: Lab: CFA of a CBBE survey; free/open source.

title: seminr / cSEM (R) - PLS-SEM brand equity models
author_source: Ray, Danks, Calero Valdez (seminr 2.5.0, GPL-3); Rademaker & Schuberth (cSEM 0.7.1, GPL-3), CRAN
note: PLS-SEM for brand equity driver models (brand image -> trust -> loyalty) with bootstrapping and HTMT; open alternative to SmartPLS.
course_use: Lab/thesis; free/open source.

title: semopy / prince (Python)
author_source: semopy 2.3.11 (PyPI); prince 0.21.0 (Max Halford, MIT)
note: Python equivalents: semopy for CFA/SEM of CBBE scales; prince for correspondence analysis/PCA perceptual maps from brand x attribute tables.
course_use: Lab for Python-track students; free/open source.

title: Chapman & Feit companion code - R for Marketing Research and Analytics (2nd ed.)
author_source: Chris Chapman & Elea McDonnell Feit, Springer 2019, code and data on r-forge
note: Chapter 8 code: PCA, exploratory factor analysis and perceptual maps from consumer brand ratings (10 brands x 9 adjectives); classroom slides and exercises.
course_use: Lab: ready-made perceptual-mapping exercise; code free; book via SpringerLink - WU-Lizenz prüfen.

title: Python for Marketing Research and Analytics - companion notebooks
author_source: Jason Schwarz, Chris Chapman, Elea McDonnell Feit, Springer 2020, GitHub org python-marketing-research
note: Jupyter/Colab notebooks incl. the brand-rating PCA/factor analysis and perceptual-map chapter (Python version of the brand ratings exercise).
course_use: Lab for Python track; code free; book via SpringerLink - WU-Lizenz prüfen.

title: tapilab/mksci-2015-brand-perceptions (GitHub)
author_source: Aron Culotta & Jennifer Cutler, GitHub replication code, MIT licence, 2015
note: Replication code for 'Mining Brand Perceptions from Twitter Social Networks' (Marketing Science 2016): infers brand perceptions (eco-friendliness, luxury, nutrition) from follower overlap with exemplar accounts.
course_use: Advanced lab/seminar replication; free/open source (Twitter/X data access now restricted).

title: hannesdatta/brand-equity-journal-of-marketing (GitHub)
author_source: Hannes Datta (Tilburg), GitHub replication package, 2022
note: Replication code for Datta, Ailawadi & van Heerde (2017, Journal of Marketing) 'How well does consumer-based brand equity align with sales-based brand equity and marketing-mix response?'; uses R package marketingtools; IRI sales data proprietary.
course_use: Seminar: CBBE vs. sales-based brand equity measurement; code free, full data only via IRI.

title: aloth/yougov-brandindex-query (GitHub)
author_source: Alexander Loth, Python client for YouGov BrandIndex API, GPL-3.0, 2019
note: Python client to query BrandIndex brand perception metrics via API (requires a BrandIndex licence).
course_use: Only with BrandIndex access; open source.

title: Miro - Visual and Verbal Audit template (Miroverse)
author_source: Gratifiles via Miroverse, Miro whiteboard template, 2025
note: Collaborative board to audit a brand's visual and verbal identity (what works, gaps, potential) before a rebrand; Miro also offers brand positioning and brand guidelines templates.
course_use: Workshop/group project; Miro free plan; Miro Education plan free for students/teachers.

title: Canva - brand guidelines / social media audit templates
author_source: Canva Pty Ltd, online design tool (Canva for Education free), 2026
note: No native 'brand audit' template found; brand-guidelines and social-media-audit templates can be adapted to present audit findings (brand element inventory, touchpoints, recommendations).
course_use: Presentation of audit results; Canva for Education free for teachers/students.

title: Chapman & Feit brand ratings data (rintro-chapter8.csv / brand.ratings)
author_source: Chapman & Feit, R for Marketing Research and Analytics 2e, simulated data, r-forge, 2019
note: 1,000 rows (100 respondents x 10 brands a-j), 10 variables: 9 adjective ratings 1-10 (perform, leader, latest, fun, serious, bargain, value, trendy, rebuy) + brand. Classic input for PCA/factor analysis and perceptual maps. All chapter data as ZIP: data/ChapmanFeit-RforMarketing2e-data.zip.
course_use: Lab: perceptual map, brand positioning; free direct CSV download (simulated teaching data).

title: Python for Marketing Research and Analytics - brand ratings data
author_source: Schwarz, Chapman & Feit, Springer 2020, GitHub
note: Same simulated brand ratings dataset (10 brands, 9 attributes) loaded in Python notebooks for PCA/perceptual maps.
course_use: Lab (Python); free.

title: Twitter US Airline Sentiment
author_source: CrowdFlower / Figure Eight, Kaggle dataset, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, 2015
note: 14,640 tweets about 6 US airlines (United, US Airways, American, Southwest, Delta, Virgin America) labelled positive/neutral/negative with negative-reason codes - compare brand sentiment and complaint drivers across competitors.
course_use: Lab: competitive brand sentiment; free (Kaggle login).

title: Consumer Reviews of Amazon Products (Datafiniti)
author_source: Datafiniti, Kaggle dataset (also mirrored as Zenodo record 18758751), CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, 2019
note: ~34,000 reviews of Amazon-brand products (Kindle, Fire TV, Echo) with ratings, review text, dates, brand/category - product-level brand image and sentiment.
course_use: Lab: text mining of brand reviews; free (Kaggle login).

title: Amazon Reviews 2023 (McAuley Lab)
author_source: Hou et al., UCSD McAuley Lab, project site + Hugging Face, 2024
note: 571M reviews (1996-2023) across 33 categories with item metadata incl. brand/store - filter by brand for large-scale brand perception and attribute mining.
course_use: Advanced lab/thesis; free for research (large; use category subsets).

title: Twitter Entity Sentiment Analysis
author_source: jp797498e, Kaggle dataset, 2020
note: ~74,000 training tweets + validation set labelled by entity (brands/games e.g. Microsoft, Nvidia, Amazon, Google, Facebook) and sentiment (positive/negative/neutral/irrelevant).
course_use: Lab: brand-level sentiment comparison; free (Kaggle login).

title: Customer Support on Twitter
author_source: Thought Vector, Kaggle dataset, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, 2017
note: ~3M tweets/replies between consumers and large brands' support accounts (Apple, Amazon, Spotify, airlines, telcos) - audit of service touchpoints and brand response behaviour.
course_use: Lab/project; free (Kaggle login).

title: Sentiment140
author_source: Go, Bhayani & Huang (Stanford), Kaggle mirror, 2009
note: 1.6M tweets with automatic polarity labels; filter for brand names (e.g. Nike, Apple) to illustrate brand sentiment tracking.
course_use: Lab; free (Kaggle login); dated, noisy labels.

title: TweetEval (sentiment subset)
author_source: Barbieri et al. (Cardiff NLP), Hugging Face dataset, 2020
note: Benchmark of 7 tweet classification tasks incl. sentiment (~60k tweets) - evaluate/fine-tune sentiment models before applying them to brand mentions.
course_use: Lab (NLP); free/open.

title: Bag Brands Sentiment Dataset
author_source: Mochamad Nurul Huda (Universitas Pendidikan Indonesia), Zenodo, CC BY 4.0, 2023
note: 2,881 tweets on 7 luxury/fashion bag brands (Gucci, Chanel, Dior, Louis Vuitton, Prada, Hermes, Supreme); one XLSX (446 kB) - luxury brand perception comparison.
course_use: Lab: luxury brand sentiment; free download.

title: Cross-Language AI Brand Reputation (66 brands, 12 languages)
author_source: Dmitrij Zatuchin (EEK / Rankfor.AI), Zenodo, CC BY 4.0, 2026, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20794390
note: 35,640 grounded LLM responses (GPT-5.4, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Perplexity Sonar Pro) about 66 European brands in 12 languages incl. German; sentiment, recommendation share, 150,093 source attributions, 196,020 embedding similarities; 50.6 MB ZIP with reproduction script.
course_use: Seminar/project on AI brand perception (LLM visibility); free download.

title: Brand Equity survey dataset (Mendeley Data)
author_source: Shun Chi Yu (Krirk University), Mendeley Data, CC BY 4.0, 2026, DOI 10.17632/c3nt3zjt36
note: Questionnaire data with six 4-item constructs (BT, BC, CD, CL, PV, PQ); sample size and codebook sparsely documented - usable for CFA/PLS-SEM practice after checking.
course_use: Lab: CFA/PLS-SEM practice; free; check documentation first.

title: Datta, Ailawadi & van Heerde (2017) - CBBE vs. SBBE replication data (open survey part)
author_source: DataverseNL, DOI 10.34894/ELVF0J; companion to GitHub repo hannesdatta/brand-equity-journal-of-marketing
note: Open survey data on category characteristics used alongside consumer-based brand equity (survey) and IRI scanner sales data; IRI data proprietary (request via IRI).
course_use: Seminar on validity of brand equity measures; partially open.

title: Culotta & Cutler - Twitter brand perception data
author_source: Culotta & Cutler, Marketing Science 2016, GitHub tapilab (MIT)
note: Code and survey-validated perception scores for 200+ brands on eco-friendliness, luxury and nutrition, inferred from Twitter follower networks; raw Twitter data must be re-collected (now restricted).
course_use: Seminar replication/discussion; free.

title: LogoDet-3K
author_source: Wang et al., 2022, GitHub (Kaggle mirror lyly99/logodet3k)
note: 158,652 images, 3,000 logo categories, ~194k annotated logo objects in 9 super-categories - brand element / visual identity exercises (logo recognition, visual listening).
course_use: Advanced lab (computer vision); free for research.

title: YouGov Ratings (public brand popularity and fame rankings)
author_source: YouGov plc, public web rankings, quarterly, 2026
note: Free quarterly popularity (% positive opinion) and fame rankings for brands, people and organisations by country (US, UK, DE etc.) - quick awareness/liking benchmarks.
course_use: Exploratory audit input; free (manual copy, no bulk download).

title: Interbrand Best Global Brands (annual ranking)
author_source: Interbrand, annual since 2000, web tables
note: Top 100 brand values (USD) with year-on-year change and brand strength factors; historic rankings online - financial brand-value benchmark.
course_use: Benchmark/discussion; free online (no official CSV; copy tables).

title: Kantar BrandZ Most Valuable Global Brands
author_source: Kantar, annual report and ranking, 2026
note: Top 100 brand values combining financial data with consumer brand-equity survey (Meaningful/Different/Salient); full report PDF after registration.
course_use: Benchmark; free with registration.

title: Brand Finance Brandirectory - Austria report
author_source: Brand Finance plc, Brandirectory, annual rankings 2026
note: Brand value and Brand Strength Index (BSI) for the most valuable Austrian brands plus global and sector rankings; tables online, full reports on request.
course_use: Benchmark for Austrian brand audits; free online tables.

title: European Brand Institute - Eurobrand / top Austrian brands
author_source: European Brand Institute (Vienna), annual brand valuation study
note: Annual Eurobrand ranking of the most valuable European and Austrian brands (ISO 10668-based valuation) - local benchmark data.
course_use: Benchmark; summaries free online, full study paid.

title: Statista - brand KPIs and brand rankings
author_source: Statista GmbH, database (incl. Consumer Insights brand KPIs)
note: Brand KPIs (awareness, popularity, usage, loyalty, buzz) per brand and country incl. Austria/Germany; brand rankings and market shares.
course_use: Project: secondary data for brand inventory; WU-Lizenz prüfen (WU library access).

title: BAV (BrandAsset Valuator) database
author_source: BAV Group (WPP/VML), proprietary brand database; academic access via licence/WRDS where subscribed
note: Large brand-equity database (tens of thousands of brands, 50+ countries): Differentiation, Relevance, Esteem, Knowledge pillars and ~48 image attributes.
course_use: Seminar/thesis; access restricted - WU-Lizenz prüfen (WRDS).

title: Google Trends - brand search interest data
author_source: Google LLC, free web data (CSV export per query)
note: Weekly/monthly normalised search interest (0-100) by brand, Austria/Bundesland, since 2004; CSV export or gtrendsR/pytrends - share-of-search analysis.
course_use: Lab: share of search for Austrian brands; free.

title: Media-Analyse (MA) Austria
author_source: Verein Arbeitsgemeinschaft Media-Analysen, annual reach study
note: Reach data for Austrian print media and target-group profiles - media touchpoint context for Austrian brand audits; key tables online.
course_use: Project context data; free tables online.

title: OeWA - Oesterreichische Webanalyse
author_source: OeWA (Austrian web analytics), monthly reach figures
note: Monthly unique users/visits of Austrian websites - digital touchpoint benchmarks for brand audits of Austrian media brands.
course_use: Project context data; free online tables.

title: data.europa.eu - Eurobarometer and consumer datasets
author_source: European Union, Open Data Portal
note: Eurobarometer consumer attitude data (trust, sustainability attitudes, consumer conditions) as country context; mostly CC BY 4.0.
course_use: Context data; free/open.
